preconditions.description: The number of test cases T_cases is an integer between 1 and 10 inclusive.
Each input string S has a length N of at least 2.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in {'A', 'B'} for c in S) for S in test_cases_strings)
preconditions.description: Each input string S consists only of characters 'A' and 'B'.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one line for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((output_line == '-1' and not any(subsequence_count(S, cand) == 2 for cand in all_subsequences(S))) or (output_line != '-1' and subsequence_count(S, output_line) == 2) for output_line, S in zip(output_lines, test_cases_strings))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if the output is '-1', no string appears exactly twice as a subsequence in S; otherwise, the output string appears exactly twice as a subsequence in S.
